title: MÉTODOS DE AJUSTE EN MODELOS DE APRENDIZAJE SUPERVISADO ANTE DESBALANCEO DE CLASES
summary: A Master's thesis (TFM) project, done in collaboration with insurance company MAPFRE, that builds a framework to handle class imbalance in fraud-detection models and calibrate their output probabilities against real-world frequencies. It generates synthetic minority-class data and evaluates it with SDV's CTGAN, TVAE and GaussianCopula synthesizers plus SDV metadata objects and SDMetrics quality/diagnostic reports, all run directly via the sdv and sdmetrics Python APIs.
